title: You don’t need to believe in a god to get a religious exemption from using AI at work
text: David Durman, a University of Kentucky administrator, recently earned a religious exemption from using AI in the workplace.

title: AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says. But first, it will spend big.
text: Amazon wants to be the king of AI cloud computing and become the first $1 trillion revenue business. But to do that it will have to continue on its capex spending spree, its CEO said Thursday.

title: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
text: As AI transforms how people find information online, Reddit is rethinking its open-web roots to protect its audience and business.

title: Rivian expands joint venture with VW to include AI assistant
text: Rivian doesn't disclose if the value of its $5.8 billion joint venture will expand as a result.

title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT
text: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings is buying ADT in a $15.3 billion deal, with plans to bring AI to the home security business.

title: Meta quietly launches an AI fashion app called Style Sketch
text: The app connects to Instagram to build a virtual closet from photos you’ve already shared, or lets you add items manually by snapping a photo, recording a quick video, or uploading images from your camera roll.

title: Granola crunches up a dictation feature to compete with Wispr
text: Uno reverse! After Wispr added meeting notes to its dictation app, Granola is adding dictation to its meeting notetaker. The voice AI wars are getting interesting.

title: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity
text: Mistral says its new model can afford organizations a kind of control over its cyber defenses that closed models can't.

title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
text: OpenAI’s updated Model Spec outlines five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.

title: US investigated Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO
text: A top executive of a Singapore AI cloud company that was accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China could also have been a Chinese spy, sources have told the New York Times.

title: Ex-Palantir execs launch Dream with $17M from a16z to build AI world models for construction
text: Dream is grounded in real physics and construction standards. Just as LLMs learn from text, Dream's world model is trained on more than 100 million square feet of building data gathered from permit archives across the United States.

title: Wabi, the AI agent that builds mini apps, now valued at $1.25B after latest round
text: On Thursday, AI app Wabi, now describing itself as a "personal agent," said it has raised $55 million at a $1.25 billion valuation.

title: Deepgram acquires Pipecat-maker Daily to bolster its voice AI infrastructure
text: With Pipecat, Deepgram will likely gain a deeper understanding of real-time voice and video infrastructure.

title: Amazon updates Alexa to help you manage shopping lists and subscriptions and update delivery instructions
text: The update allows you to use Alexa to create lists, register them, see what's on them, and add or edit items. You can also manage subscriptions.

title: How we detect frontier model misalignment
text: OpenAI uses layered monitoring to detect frontier model misalignment and unauthorized agent behavior so responders can intervene before incidents escalate.

title: How Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence
text: Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence with OpenAI. Lawyers review grouped documents, summaries, and reports before advising clients.

title: Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion
text: Microsoft has never disclosed Azure's quarterly revenue in dollars. But for the first time, we can see just how close it is getting to besting the biggest competitor in the market, AWS.

title: Google expands AI Search ads globally as core ad growth slows
text: The announcement came alongside parent company Alphabet's third-quarter earnings report, which saw revenue grow 25% year over year to $127.6 billion.
